title: Elf Bar ElfX Replacement Pods 2ml - 3 Pods
description: Enhance your vaping experience with the Elf Bar ELFX Replacement Pods, specifically designed for the Elf Bar ELFX Pod Kit. These pods come in two resistance options—0.6ohm for a looser, more airy RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vape, and 0.8ohm for a tighter, more restricted MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw—catering to different vaping preferences. Each pod features a 2ml e-liquid capacity and utilizes a top-filling design for mess-free refills. Incorporating SSS Leak-Resistant Technology, these pods ensure a secure, leak-free vaping experience, enhancing both the flavour and longevity of your vape sessions. The fixed coil design simplifies the replacement process, eliminating the need for messy coil swaps. Simply replace the entire pod for a fresh, flavourful start. The package includes three replacement pods, making it easy to keep your device performing at its best. Whether you're at home or on the go, these replacement pods are super-useful for maintaining the performance and efficiency of your Elf Bar ELFX device. For the ultimate Elf Bar experience, pair the ELFX pods with Elf Bar’s ElfLiq range of 50/50 Nic Salt e-liquids, featuring classic Elf Bar flavours. We Recommend pairing these pods with 50/50 , Nic salt or High PG E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
